fighterA.name: Character A

dossier.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges opponents to physically tear them apart with his bare hands, supported by corrosive rage plasma that burns through matter and space itself.
dossier.advantage: Red ring instead of a heart and inhuman strength. The ring keeps him alive even after fatal wounds, and his physical power allows him to crush energy barriers and the armor of deities with his bare hands.
dossier.mentality: A furious zealot driven by revenge. He knows no mercy or hesitation – he pushes forward with a fury that grows more powerful the more hatred and anger the enemy shows him.
dossier.quote: I am Atrocitus, lord and master of the Red Lantern Corps. I am the one who will destroy the Guardians and all they stand for. I am wrath, I am hate, I am righteous vengeance!

victories: Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire (group overpowering)

powers: Red Lantern plasma output, constructs, blood magic and rituals, flight, and Butcher-linked rage dynamics.
tools: Emotional-spectrum manipulation and high-pressure ranged offense.
weaknesses: Ring or construct-output dependence and front-loaded control windows.
Prolonged direct brawls can reduce his tactical edge.

crucialFeats: Bound the Butcher inside his power battery
Kept fighting after his heart was removed
Used blood magic to read the future and track rage paths
Burned through the fabric of space with rage plasma
Overpowered Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire together

fighterB.name: Character B

dossier.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. Relies on pure physical strength and constant forward momentum, crushing everything under his strikes.
dossier.advantage: Limitless strength scaling and regeneration. The more injured and angry he gets, the stronger he becomes, making him practically unbeatable in a war of attrition.
dossier.mentality: A stubborn and wild destroyer. He does not calculate or retreat – he pushes forward until all resistance is leveled to the ground.

powers: Gamma-based strength growth, regeneration, thunderclap/shockwave output, and extreme stamina.
weaknesses: Limited precision utility at long range versus dedicated control users.
Strategy set is narrower when denied sustained contact.

crucialFeats: Planet and moon collateral output from World Breaker scale
Redirected Juggernaut's charge through tactical strength

tactical-board.headline: TACTICAL BOARD // ATROCITUS VS HULK
tactical-board.subtitle: Butcher versus Worldbreaker
tactical-board.lane: Atrocitus wins by keeping the fight structured. Hulk wins by turning structure into a repeat contact loop.

final-summary.headline: FINAL SUMMARY
final-summary.subtitle: Summary
final-summary.line1: Atrocitus wins the paper comparison, 85.6 vs 83.9.
final-summary.line2: Hulk wins more real fights because repeat contact and regeneration create the cleaner finish route.
final-summary.line3: Atrocitus only flips the matchup if distance and control hold from start to finish.
